objective: Establish a bounded-autonomy one-floor governance cell with explicit action contracts, proposal-only Ascalon cognition, trust-separated boundary inspection, paired healing leases and fencing, and proof-based closure without changing the F00-F07 topology.

rulesConsidered: Floor Guardian remains highest authority inside a floor.
Ascalon remains bounded cognition and may not become sovereign authority.
F07 remains the final production verification/release boundary.
The existing F00-F07 topology is unchanged.
The mandatory .okf decision protocol remains the architectural gate.

forensicFindings: GuardianKernel already provides a floor-local autonomy loop and GuardianPolicy already enforces cross-floor, critical, repeated-failure and irreversible-action boundaries.
The existing healer substrate has resource locks, deduplication and rollback but did not have a per-resource fencing epoch in ResourceLock contracts.
HealerEngine currently executes an allocated squad sequentially; the new JointHealingSession is therefore a foundation rather than a production scheduler replacement.
CaseManager retains a legacy direct resolveCase() escape hatch; the new ResolutionGate defines the target closure proof but is not yet wired into every legacy caller.
Advisor is currently represented mostly by concepts/UI/docs; this wave introduces CounselPacket but does not claim a production Advisor runtime.
No complete production BDA boundary is wired into every live floor handoff; this wave provides the boundary subsystem foundation.
changes: Added FloorActionGate with capability, precondition, state-version, trust and authorization checks.
Added FloorGovernanceCell state machine and Ascalon proposal-only adapter.
Added FloorBlackboard and typed CounselPacket projection.
Added JointHealingSession manager with per-resource mutation leases and fencing epochs.
Extended RepairLockManager with fencing-aware mutation leases while preserving legacy lock callers.
Added ResolutionGate requiring BDA proof + Auditor proof + Guardian closure grant.
Added focused negative tests and reusable floor design documentation.
Added .okf decision, architecture, audit and index entries.

security.notes: The runtime changes are primarily typed control-plane/library contracts. Repository CI and configured security lanes remain authoritative. No external credentials or secrets were added.

verificationPlan: Run repository CI and FactoryOS typecheck/tests.
Review negative FGC tests, especially trust-boundary, stale-fencing and proof-based resolution cases.
Do not promote this wave to production authority until CI evidence is green and the target-vs-current gaps remain accurately documented.
Track baseline CLM/LLM typecheck debt separately; do not silently attribute it to the FGC wave.
dispositionRationale: Wave-1 code and documentation are implemented on the PR branch, but repository CI/security evidence is still pending; no production merge is claimed.

repositoryCI.baselineTypecheckFinding: Existing main branch CI already failed on identical CLMDecisionAdapter/LLMDecisionAdapter TypeScript errors before this FGC branch.
